menu.subtitle: Featuring nutritional and delicious vegetarian specialties prepared from tofu, tempeh, soymilk, and miso.

items.name: Tofu Burger
items.description: a combination of fresh organic tofu, blended with sauteed carrots, mushrooms, onions, wheat germ, nutritional yeast, bread crumbs, and seasoning. A Hit!
items.notes: Served on a ww. sesame bun with sprouts, tomato, our special sauce, marinade, and a dill pickle.

items.name: Tempeh Burger
items.description: an Indonesian soy patty with brown rice imparting a mushroom flavor and packed with 26 g. of protein. High energy, low in calories.
items.notes: Served on a ww. sesame bun with sprouts, tomato, our special sauce, marinade, and a dill pickle.

items.name: Soysage Burger
items.description: spicy, rich flavor reminiscent of sausage. High in fiber and protein, low in fat and calories.
items.notes: Served on a ww. sesame bun with sprouts, tomato, our special sauce, marinade, and a dill pickle.

items.name: Falafel Burger
items.description: garbanzos (chick peas) and a host of spices too lengthy to list. A zesty sandwich served with our sesame tahini dressing.
items.notes: Served on a ww. sesame bun with sprouts, tomato, our special sauce, marinade, and a dill pickle.

items.name: Tofalafel
items.description: we add our Israeli garbanzo mix to the tofu patty and East meets Zest! Served with our sesame tahini dressing.
items.notes: Served on a ww. sesame bun with sprouts, tomato, our special sauce, marinade, and a dill pickle.

items.name: TLT
items.description: open face sandwich with crispy strips of tempeh, lettuce, and tomato.
items.notes: Served on a ww. sesame bun with sprouts, tomato, our special sauce, marinade, and a dill pickle.

items.name: Shogun S.C.
items.description: a marinated slab of firm tofu, grilled and marinated again. Our quarter pounder!
items.notes: Served on a ww. sesame bun with sprouts, tomato, our special sauce, marinade, and a dill pickle.

items.name: Mock Chicken

items.notes: Served on Grain Bin ww with sprouts, tomato, soy mayo, and a dill pickle.
